subject: general
question: Ravi has to go from Hyderabad to Delhi. The distance between Hyderabad and Delhi is 1,200 kms. He decides to travel 25% of the distance on foot, 30% of the distance by bus, 15% of the distance by train and the remaining distance by an airplane. What is the distance travelled by Ravi by an Airplane?
solution:
GIVEN :

Total Distance to be covered = 1200 kms.

Distance travelled on foot = 25%

Distance travelled by bus = 30%

Distance travelled by train = 15%

CONCEPT :

Remaining Distance travelled by airplane = Total Distance - (Distance travelled on foot + Distance travelled by bus + Distance travelled by train)

CALCULATION :

Let the Total distance be 100%.

According to question,

100% = 1200 Kms

Remaining Distance travelled by airplane = Total Distance - (Distance travelled on foot + Distance travelled by bus + Distance travelled by train)

⇒ 100% - (25% + 30% + 15%)

⇒ 100% - 70%

⇒ 30%

Remaining Distance = 30%

Now,

100% = 1200 Kms

∴ 30% = 1200 × (30/100) = 360

⇒ Remaining Distance = 360 Kms

**∴ The distance travelled by Ravi by an Airplane is 360 Km.**
